context: Tests whether the agent adds a Keep a Changelog entry in the right category (Fixed) and style (imperative verb, user-facing) and cuts a 1.4.0 release correctly: verifies preconditions, stamps today's date, preserves existing wording, keeps a fresh empty Unreleased section on top, and neither tags, commits, nor pushes.

checklist.name: New Fixed entry added
checklist.description: CHANGELOG.md contains a new bullet about the socket connector no longer retrying authentication failures / duplicate-login loop.

checklist.name: Entry under correct category
checklist.description: The new bullet sits under a '### Fixed' heading rather than Added/Changed/Removed - under '## [Unreleased]' before the release is cut, and under '## [1.4.0]' once it has been.

checklist.name: Entry style matches existing
checklist.description: The new bullet leads with an imperative verb and is a single line describing a user-facing change, in the same style as the existing 'Fixed' bullets (e.g. no past tense 'We fixed…', no file paths, no commit hashes).

checklist.name: Release section created
checklist.description: CHANGELOG.md now has a '## [1.4.0] - <today's date>' section with today's actual date (whatever 'date +%F' yields at run time), not a guessed date.

checklist.name: All entries moved into release
checklist.description: The 1.4.0 section contains all four entries (three original + the new Fixed entry), with each original bullet's wording unchanged.

checklist.name: Fresh empty Unreleased restored
checklist.description: A fresh empty '## [Unreleased]' heading sits above the 1.4.0 section, with no placeholder bullet under it.

checklist.name: Header and format preserved
checklist.description: The Keep a Changelog header lines ('The format is based on…', 'Semantic Versioning') are unchanged and remain in their original place above the release sections.

checklist.name: No version preconditions violated
checklist.description: The agent did not release when Unreleased was empty, did not pick an already-used version, and picked 1.4.0 (higher than any version in the file). If preconditions were met it proceeded without asking.

checklist.name: No tag/commit/push
checklist.description: No git tag, commit, or push was made during this scenario (git log shows only the initial commit).

checklist.name: No invented sections or placeholders
checklist.description: No placeholder bullets under empty category headings and no new category headings without entries.
